object.description: Setup: current build installed with 2 saved workouts; a test build with a higher schema version and no migration. Steps: 1. Read the database builder in DatabaseModule.kt. 2. Install the test build over the current build and open the app. 3. Reinstall the current build, keeping the data, and open History. Expected: The builder has no destructive fallback, and after step 3 both workouts are listed with unchanged distance and duration. Fails today (the database is erased).
